test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If the radius of a sphere is 7 cm, then the surface area in (cm2) of the sphere is ______. (Take π = \frac{{22}}{7})
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the sphere, r = 7 cm

**Formula Used:**

Surface area of a sphere = 4 × π × r²

Given π = (22)/(7)

**Calculation:**

Surface area = 4 × π × r²

⇒ Surface area = 4 × (22)/(7) × 7²

⇒ Surface area = 4 × (22)/(7) × 49

⇒ Surface area = 4 × 22 × 7

⇒ Surface area = 88 × 7

⇒ Surface area = 616 cm²

**The surface area of the sphere is 616 cm².**
